title: What Microbiome Diet Services Is
definition: Microbiome Diet Services: diets tuned to your gut microbiome.

t: 2030 — First service hulls products reach price parity: microbiome test
title: 2030 — First service hulls products reach price parity: microbiome test
definition: 2030 milestone on the Microbiome Diet Services roadmap.
description:
First service hulls products reach price parity: microbiome tests cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the microbiome tests results have to replicate outside the lab, service logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and meal matching operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed microbiome tests demonstrations, service logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting meal matching uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Microbiome Diet Services readiness from component maturity.

definition: Simulates Microbiome Diet Services operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where microbiome tests monitoring, service logistics redundancy, or meal matching maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Microbiome Diet Services Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Microbiome Diet Services: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Microbiome Diet Services — diets tuned to your gut microbiome.

Phase 1 — Prove (microbiome tests): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (service logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (meal matching): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (re-testing): service hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
